plan.extraction: Original 10-K only; frozen v6 standalone Item 7 to Item 7A/8 candidates; no silent full-report fallback
plan.quality_flags: Multiple body candidates; <1500 or >30000 words; end heading Item 8; source fraction >0.65 or start fraction <0.03. Flagged candidates require explicit review before any fit.
plan.bulk_review: All flagged candidates plus an outcome-independent sector/year/hash sample of ordinary candidates before supervised fitting; no automatic claim of full-corpus semantic correctness.
plan.scope: 100 fixed retained non-financial reference-cohort issuers: 80 existing training-role, 20 existing held-role. Does not redefine historical membership or untouched status. No substitution for absent financials/text. Sampled for computational feasibility, not model outcomes.

scope: Original annual 10-K metadata and frozen-parser candidates only. Every bulk candidate is unreviewed until the declared quality process. Foreign forms/amendments, extraction abstentions and failures are explicit, with no replacement or invented text.
